prompt.generated_prompt_string: A high-fashion editorial portrait of an adult man standing still in the center of a bright, clean, slightly abstract winter city setting, looking directly toward the camera with a calm stoic expression. He has dark curly hair, thin metal-frame glasses, and wears a brown hooded technical jacket with matching trousers. Surround him with anonymous people passing by in strong motion blur, while his face and clothing remain sharply focused. Emphasize the visual contrast between static presence and moving silhouettes. Use film composition, pure art-photography sensibility, soft magazine texture, overcast daylight, a 50mm lens at f/2.8, controlled slow-shutter blur, and portrait 4:5 framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed
